name: Thomas Y. Barclay

about: Thomas Y. Barclay strives to provide businesses and individuals with the judicious legal representation he has consistently delivered for over 20 years. From the Law Office of Thomas Y. Barclay, APLC, in Downey, California, he handles all manners of real estate matters, including complex, high-stakes commercial and residential real estate litigation, and his clientele includes residential home buyers, contractors, sellers and agents, among many others.

A 2000 B.A. degree graduate in political science and general social ecology from the University of California, Irvine, Mr. Barclay went on to attend Loyola Law School, where he served as the Note and Comment Editor for the International and Comparative Law Review. He received his Juris Doctor in 2003, and in the same year, he obtained his license to practice law in California.

Across his illustrious career, Mr. Barclay has garnered the adulation of his peers for his efficacious work ethic and dedication to seeing his clients through their tumultuous legal issues with grace and poise. A stalwart champion for his clients, he pursues every available legal avenue and fights tooth and nail to get them the respite they deserve. For his many contributions, he is rated “Excellent” on Avvo.

Outside his law practice, Mr. Barclay stays actively involved within his legal community through his many affiliations with legal organizations, such as the Los Angeles County Bar Association and the Southeast District Bar Association, helping to raise the standard of service in his industry to even greater heights.
honors: Loyola Law School Los Angeles, International and Comparative Law Review, Note and Comment Editor
